shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat, ledger-aware island logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (sky-view only).
- Selection survives column view switches. Pocket maps: celestial/climate via GROUND map; fog-mesh self-heal on first view. Underground biome trial notes in pass 16.
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- Logistics doctrine: storage priority wins; consumers fetch back per need; demand hauls are residual-clamped and ledger-aware (2026-07-25).

## REMOVED FEATURES (user directives, revisit-ready postmortems)
**SKYLIGHTS (round 7)** — full postmortem in pass 16: biome lighting mode, stale fog bakes (self-heal KEPT and still active), pocket-map sun rule (KEPT as locked decision), the unverified shaft chain.
**MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12)** — removed entirely per user ("we'll revisit some other time") after live testing showed multi-directional lips and mis-filled tunnels on real terrain. Deleted: GenStep_ABSkyRivers, AutoSkyGen, Waterfalls things/defs/sound/textures, mountainRivers setting, river dev tools, generator entry, Keyed strings; asset manifest emptied; zero stragglers, build green.
**Revisit dossier (what round 8-12 iteration established, so none of it is rediscovered):**
- 1.6 water facts: riverFlowMap is per-variant optional, riverGraph is never scribed (flow must be optional); wide rivers are IsWater composites (IsRiver core + still fringe); width>20 strips the roof (canyons, not tunnels).
- Detection needs THREE signals: thick-roof tunnel, clean canyon flanks (axis scan), and mountain-closeness density (ragged massifs) — all three implemented and functional at removal time.
- Hydrology that user wants: per-FACE — upstream face keeps a tunnel apron (river dives in), downstream lifts with falls at the exit; mountain-source stretches lift whole; the seal must fill the ENTIRE water body (fringe included) + rebuild rock + thick roof.
- Working machinery at removal: ExecuteLift (carve/seal/banks/rim/flow-copy/lips), per-stretch verdicts, multi-source BFS apron, auto sky gen hook, force-lift dev tool. THE UNSOLVED PART: lip DIRECTION/placement on real terrain (multi-directional falls — the flow-dot heuristic misfires on wide/complex water bodies; needs a per-stretch single-exit-face resolution, e.g. one dominant outflow face per lifted stretch instead of per-cell lip decisions) and seal correctness on braided/cave terrain.
- All transferable engine lessons saved to lore (biomes topic).

## VERIFIED
RMB cross-level (USER) · basement behavior (USER) · Batch A (USER) · **bug-wave fixes "mostly fixed" (USER, run 2026-07-25): mech charge crash gone, cross-level bill supply + mech RMB working.**

## USER BUG WAVE 2026-07-24 (5 reports, root cause + fixes — see pass 23)
Root cause: `Invoke(null)` on instance `ShouldAutoRecharge` → TargetException → Logistics kill switch tripped each session → silent death of all demand/haul flows. FIXED (instance invoke, virtual dispatch respects WVC). Plus: demand fan-cap fix (presence-filtered registration, uncapped availability), forbidden-aware availability, mech RMB cross-level orders (PlayerCommandable). Report 2 (Horax spam) ruled NOT ours; report 5 "incompatible group 1" = per-map storage-group name collision. Animal area-migration question still OPEN with user.

## FERRY DISCIPLINE REWORK (2026-07-25, follow-up report: "hauling TO stairs instead of THROUGH")
User screenshot: stacks staged/stranded at the stair mouth, duplicates ferried "when not required". (Red-X items in the shot are pre-forbidden map litter — colonists never touch forbidden things; the real issue was the unforbidden staged stacks.) Three structural gaps, all fixed:
1. **In-flight ledger** (CrossLevelDemand): every demand-routed haul claims (pawn → demandMap, def, count, 5000-tick expiry); want queries net the ledger out, consuming against islands in scan order. Entries self-validate (live check: our stairs/haul jobs, or arrived-on-demand-map-still-carrying = store leg) — no driver hooks; acting pawn's own claim excluded from its queries (haul-back must not block itself). Claim sites: haul giver, fetch giver outbound (estimate) + haul-back (refresh), construction supply, onward hop.
2. **Residual count clamps**: TryRouteDemand/FindFetchableDemand/TargetLevelFor now count-aware (`wanted`/`demandCount` out; VerdictEntry carries count). Demand hauls carry min(stack, capacity, residual); storage moves keep full stacks (vanilla parity); urgent/player-forced flows unclamped.
3. **Onward demand hop** (StairTransfer.TryOnwardDemandHop): arriving cargo with NO accepting local storage continues through the next stairwell itself when a further level still wants it (drop-then-requeue AB_HaulAcrossLevels — driver needs a spawned target). Never routes back toward cameFrom (ping-pong guard). Storage-wins ordering preserved: store check runs first.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky + basement (starter stairs) · AB: basement diagnostic · AB: light diagnostic · AB: RMB diagnostic.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE
0. **Ferry discipline verification: single hauler covers a small shortfall (no duplicate ferries), demand hauls carry clamped counts, basement→sky chain completes via onward hop, no unforbidden stacks stranded at stair mouths.**
1. Below-level lighting from the sky view (lamp pools through the gap at night).
2. Animal flow (pet returns + wild hard-overdue escape), direct-to-blueprint hauling.
3. BAM compat (companion ferny.BetterArchitect), Batch B (meditation/pens/cell-casts/rituals), Batch C (companions: Orion.Hospitality, joeownage.automatic.airships).
4. Perf-mod smoke (non-isolated: PO + TPT live), CE-absent palette run, translation audit, soak, publishing prep.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 parity (VERIFIED, mech-inclusive) · basement (VERIFIED) · direct-to-blueprint hauling · below-level lighting · animal flow fix · mech charge routing (VERIFIED post-fix) · demand fan-cap + forbidden-availability fixes · **ferry discipline (in-flight ledger + residual clamps + onward hop)** · BAM compat · perf pass · Batch A verified · Batch B/C built pending · logistics/areas/combat as documented. REMOVED: skylights, mountain rivers.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE. Biomes! Caverns. Alpha Biomes. BM + MO. Odyssey + VLE. Misc. Robots + Robots++. Hauler's Dream + PUAH (bulk flow: in-flight registered via seed, counts unclamped — PUAH queue semantics). Allow Tool. Ancient urban ruins. CE. Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF. Medieval Trader Airships (+legacy), Hospitality (Continued). Better Architect Menu. PO + Dubs Performance Analyzer + TPT. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. WVC work modes: charge postfix dispatches virtually through their overrides.

## Status
2026-07-25 (24th pass): **ferry discipline rework built green — in-flight ledger, residual clamps, onward interchange hop.** Awaiting in-game verification (queue item 0). Open: animal area-migration question, optional guard-trip letter, optional cross-level bill storage feature.
